acceptance: A train batch runs BatchTest.Check before it opens the batch PR, through the real entry point
A journey test proves a batch whose two members pass alone and fail together ejects the later member with the cause in its brief
A host kill does not eject a member

A tree that lands after an L2 ejection meets the repo-contract pack, cover-changed, cover-strict, build, vet and gofmt before L3, and a test proves it with a member that fails only gofmt on the combined tree
fix: Build the three adapters of BatchTest, call Check from the train before the batch PR opens, move the branch to the tested tip, and return a typed result from acsrunner that separates a host failure from a build failure. Add the rest of the L2 row as PackageTest seams: the repo-contract pack, cover-changed, cover-strict, build, vet and gofmt. This pack is the answer for a tree that lands after an L2 ejection: L2 is a superset of the L1 gates, so no gate rerun is needed.
notes: BatchTest.Check has no production caller. The console train lands a batch on CI alone. Owner of the work that older text gave to I5: the three adapters (package test, predicate run, verdict store), the branch move with the tested tip refusal, the output limit, and the separation of a host failure from a build failure, which needs a typed result from acsrunner. Found by the architecture seat on the I3b rework, 2026-11-04.
